note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-22): 14 pictures chosen from 28 trial pictures (one trial idea was not made by the image service and one picture was remade higher in the frame). Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse, or at its "from" words inside the verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words. This chapter is Eliphaz's second speech: the pictures show what his words say, without taking sides. God is not pictured, Job and Eliphaz are not portrayed as biblical people, and nothing violent is shown.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21 after the sentence-by-sentence pictures did not connect: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye. A section has one or two pictures. What he said went wrong before: he could not tell why some pictures were there, could not connect them to the meaning, and some were too abstract.

sections.meaning: Eliphaz calls Job's words empty wind that do no good, and says Job's own mouth is the witness that condemns him.
ideas: A man speaks forcefully on a bare hilltop in a hot dusty gale, his pages of notes torn from his hands and scattering, with no one there to listen
A windsock blown stiff and full by a hot dry wind over a bare plain, with nothing inside it
A tumbleweed rolls across empty desert land
A man blows up a balloon until his cheeks are puffed full of air
A weathervane spins on an empty barn in a gusting wind
A man at a bathroom mirror; his own reflection points an accusing finger back at him
In a courtroom a lawyer holds up a small recorder playing a man's own words while the man in the dock covers his face
A man reads his own old letters aloud and slowly lowers them, ashamed
A man caught and tangled in the strings of his own kite
A man talks on and on at a meeting while everyone round the table has stopped listening

sections.meaning: Eliphaz says Job speaks as if he alone had overheard God's council, though the aged and wise are on Eliphaz's side, and that Job spurns God's gentle comfort and turns his spirit against God.
ideas: A man presses his ear to a tall closed double door with bright light shining through the crack
A man peers through the keyhole of a great door, light streaming out onto his face
A man stands on a hilltop among ancient rounded hills as if he were older than they are
One man stands arguing before a row of very old white-haired men and women who sit calmly and look back at him
A row of very old, weathered, white-haired faces sitting side by side
A middle-aged man lectures a great-grandfather who listens patiently
An old friend gently lays a hand on a grieving man's shoulder, and the man pulls away, eyes blazing
A friend holds out a warm mug to a man sitting on a step, and the man turns his face away in anger
A man storms out of a warm lit house into the night while someone holds a blanket out to him at the door
A close view of a man's eyes flashing with anger

sections.meaning: No mortal can be pure before God, when even the heavens are not clean in his eyes; how much less a corrupt man who drinks wrong as if it were water.
ideas: A white shirt that looks clean is held up to a bright window, and the strong light shows faint stains all through it
A well-dressed man gulps down a glass of murky brown water as if it were clear spring water
A man drinks thirstily straight from a muddy ditch
A spotless white sheet on a washing line against a dazzling sky shows a grey smudge
A clear night sky full of stars seen through a smeared window
A white glove wiped along a shelf comes away grey
A man pours glass after glass from a jug of dirty water and drinks them down
A drop of ink spreads through a glass of clear water
A newborn's hand in its mother's hand in a hospital room
A bright lamp held over a polished floor shows every speck of dust

sections.meaning: Eliphaz appeals to what he has seen for himself and to what the wise have handed down from their fathers, a people who kept their land to themselves.
ideas: An old grandfather, his grown son and a teenage grandson stand at the edge of their own wide farmland while the old man points out across it, telling them
Old wrinkled hands pass a worn handwritten family notebook to younger hands across a wooden table
A grandfather sits with a grandson looking through an old family photograph album
An old man tells a story to younger men sitting round him on a porch at evening
A fenced family farm with no other house in sight to the horizon
An old man looks steadily at the viewer as one who has seen much
A worn family map spread on a table with old hands resting on it
A father teaching his son to plough a furrow on their own land
A row of photographs of fathers and grandfathers on a farmhouse wall
An old well in a family yard with a bucket worn smooth by generations of hands

sections.meaning: The wicked man is never at peace: even in quiet times dread fills his ears, he expects disaster at any moment, and darkness is waiting for him.
ideas: In a luxurious bedroom at night a wealthy man lies wide awake, eyes open in fear, listening
In a mansion at 3 a.m. a man in a robe stares at a wall of security screens showing empty grounds
A man behind a door with many locks peers anxiously through the spyhole
A man in an expensive coat glances back over his shoulder on an empty street
A man in a crumpled expensive coat wanders an empty street of shuttered shops looking for bread, with a dark storm closing in
A man stands before an open, completely empty refrigerator in a dark kitchen of a grand house
A calm luxurious estate in sunshine with a black storm massing just beyond its walls
A man flinches at a knock on his door on a quiet evening
A man sits in a huge empty mansion with every light on, unable to rest
A man pressed against a wall as a vast storm front rolls toward him

sections.meaning: He has set himself proudly against God, fat and self-satisfied, yet he lives among houses bound for ruin, and his wealth will not last.
ideas: A man stands on a rocky outcrop in a storm, shaking his clenched fist at the dark sky
A ram charges head down at a huge mountain cliff
A man in armour charges at a mountain
A tiny boat sails straight at a huge wave
A heavy, well-fed man lounges in a gilded armchair eating, in a grand room whose walls are cracking and crumbling round him
One grand house stands in an abandoned town whose other houses are roofless and falling into heaps of stone
A sandcastle mansion being washed away by the tide
A mansion with deep cracks running up its walls, about to collapse
A man counts gold coins at a table while the ceiling above him sags
A gold-plated car rusting in the weeds of an empty lot

sections.meaning: He withers like a plant scorched before its time, dropping his fruit unripe; the household of the godless bears nothing but trouble, and fire eats up what bribery built.
ideas: A young green vine shoot whose tender tips have been shrivelled and blackened by a passing flame
A young tree on a dark hillside whose new shoots have been dried brown by a passing fire
A palm tree with dead brown fronds among green ones
Many small hard green unripe grapes lie fallen on dry ground under a vine
An olive tree shedding its white blossom onto the ground, with no fruit left on the branches
A thick envelope of banknotes on a polished table curling and burning to ash
The blackened frame of a lavish party tent burned out on a barren cracked field
A barren, cracked field where nothing grows
Hands passing an envelope of money under a restaurant table
A spider spinning a web in a dark corner

scenes.principle: Windy words that do no good: talk that is only wind.
scenes.shows: A man speaks forcefully on a bare hilltop in a hot gale, his pages of notes torn from his hand and blowing away, with no one to hear.
scenes.prompt: On a bare, dusty hilltop under a hard white midday sky, a middle-aged man in a plain shirt stands speaking forcefully with one arm thrown out, as if making a great speech. A hot, dry gale is blowing: it whips his hair and shirt and tears the pages of his notes out of his other hand, and the loose white pages fly away across the empty brown land. There is no one anywhere to hear him.

scenes.principle: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I; your own lips testify against you.
scenes.shows: A man stands before his bathroom mirror, and his own reflection points an accusing finger back at him.
scenes.prompt: In a plain bathroom in cool morning light, a middle-aged man in a white shirt stands still before the mirror over the sink, his hands at his sides, looking at himself. In the mirror his own reflection is not copying him: the reflection is raising one hand and pointing an accusing finger straight back at him, with a stern face. The mirror is at eye level in the upper part of the frame.

scenes.principle: Were you there before the hills? Do you listen in on the council of God and take its wisdom for yourself?
scenes.shows: A man presses his ear to a tall closed double door, bright light shining out through the crack.
scenes.prompt: In a dim, quiet corridor, a middle-aged man in shirtsleeves leans in and presses his ear against a tall, closed wooden double door, listening hard, his eyes sideways. Bright warm light shines out through the narrow crack between the two doors and under them, falling across his face and the floor. The doors are tall and grand; the man is small beside them.

scenes.principle: What do you know that we do not? The gray-haired and the aged are on our side.
scenes.shows: One man stands arguing before a row of white-haired old men and women who sit calmly and look back at him unconvinced.
scenes.prompt: In a plain, sunlit room with white walls, a middle-aged man stands on one side with his hand raised, arguing his case. Facing him, seated calmly in a row of wooden chairs, are six very old men and women with white hair and deeply lined faces, their hands folded, looking back at him with patient, unconvinced eyes. Soft daylight from tall windows.

scenes.principle: Are God's comforts and a gentle word too little for you? Your eyes flash and you turn your spirit against God.
scenes.shows: A kind older woman holds out a steaming mug of tea; the man at the table pushes it away with his hand, eyes flashing with anger.
scenes.prompt: In a warm kitchen in the evening, a kind older woman holds out a steaming mug of tea with both hands to a middle-aged man sitting at the table. The man refuses it: he has turned his face sharply away from her, his eyes flashing with anger, one hand raised to push it off. The lamp light is soft and warm.

scenes.principle: No mortal is pure before God, when even the heavens are not pure in his eyes.
scenes.shows: A white shirt held up to a bright window: the strong light shows stains all through what looked clean.
scenes.prompt: A close view of two hands holding up a white shirt in front of a big, bright window. In ordinary light the shirt would look clean, but the strong light shining through it shows faint grey stains and marks all through the cloth. The window light is bright clear daylight; the room around is in soft shadow.

scenes.principle: What the wise have handed down from their fathers and not hidden.
scenes.shows: Old wrinkled hands pass a worn handwritten notebook into a young man's open hands.
scenes.prompt: A close view across an old wooden kitchen table: a very old man's wrinkled hands carefully pass a worn, handwritten leather notebook, its pages soft with age, into the open hands of a young man. Soft overcast window light. The notebook has no writing visible on its cover.

scenes.principle: The wicked man has no peace: sounds of dread are in his ears even in a time of peace.
scenes.shows: Late at night a man in a dressing gown stares in fear at a wall of security screens that show only calm, empty grounds.
scenes.prompt: Late at night in a dark study of a mansion, a middle-aged man in a silk dressing gown stands tense and alone before a wall of glowing security camera screens. Every screen shows the same calm, empty grounds, gardens and gates at night, yet he stares at them with fear. The screens' blue glow lights his face.

scenes.principle: He wanders for bread, 'Where is it?', and knows a day of darkness is ready at his hand.
scenes.shows: In the dark kitchen of a grand house a man in a suit stands at a wide-open refrigerator that is completely empty.
scenes.prompt: In the dark kitchen of a grand house at night, a man in an expensive but rumpled suit stands before a huge open refrigerator that is completely empty, its cold white light falling on his hungry, frightened face. Outside the tall window behind him the sky is black.

scenes.principle: He has stretched out his hand against God and acts the mighty man against the Almighty.
scenes.shows: On a rocky height under a towering storm sky a man shakes his clenched fist up at the heavens.
scenes.prompt: On a high rocky outcrop under a dark, churning storm sky, a big, strong man in a heavy coat stands with his feet planted wide, his head thrown back, shaking his clenched fist up at the sky in defiance. Wind tears at his coat. The storm clouds tower above him, huge, and he is small against them.

scenes.principle: Fat and self-satisfied, he lives in houses ready to become heaps, and his wealth will not last.
scenes.shows: A heavy, well-fed man eats contentedly in a gilded armchair while the grand room cracks and falls apart round him.
scenes.prompt: In a once-grand room with gilded mouldings, a very heavy, well-fed man in a fine suit lounges in a gilded armchair, eating contentedly from a heaped plate, his face round and full. All around him the room is falling apart: deep cracks run up the walls, plaster is falling, and a hole has opened in the ceiling. He does not notice. Grey daylight through the hole.

scenes.principle: A flame will dry up his shoots; emptiness is all he gets in exchange.
scenes.shows: A young tree on a burnt hillside, its leaves dried brown by a passing fire, a line of flame still on the hill behind.
scenes.prompt: On a dark, smoky hillside under a heavy grey sky, a single young tree stands alone. Its new shoots and leaves, which should be green, have all been dried brown and curled by a passing fire, and grey ash covers the ground round its trunk. A last line of embers glows far off on the hill.

scenes.principle: Before his time it is paid in full: like a vine he drops his grapes unripe.
scenes.shows: Small hard green grapes lie fallen on the dry ground under a vine, dropped before they could ripen.
scenes.prompt: A low view close to the ground under an old grapevine at bright midday. In the centre of the frame, raised up on a low bank of dry, cracked earth at eye level, lie dozens of small, hard, green unripe grapes that have fallen off before their time, sharp and clear. Just above them hang a few stunted, half-empty bunches on the twisted vine. The fallen green grapes are the subject and sit in the middle of the picture, well above the bottom third.

scenes.principle: The company of the godless is barren, and fire devours the tents of bribery.
scenes.shows: The burned-out frame of a once-lavish party tent stands on barren, cracked ground, its fine cloth charred.
scenes.prompt: On a barren, cracked, grey field on an overcast morning, the blackened frame of a large, once-lavish party tent stands burned out: its canvas is gone, the metal poles scorched, scraps of gold fabric charred, and a little smoke still rising. Nothing grows anywhere on the field.
